lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 001: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: Fixed the reviewer-flagged CRITICAL in findStoreReachingSearch (src/issues/self-contaminating-search.ts): SEARCH_TOOL_RE (\b(grep|egrep|fgrep|rg)\b) was matched against raw command text with no notion of 'is this actually being invoked', so a tool-word match could begin inside a quoted needle (grep -q "rg" file), a hyphen-delimited unrelated token (gen-rg-report), a file extension (docs/x.rg), or plain echoed text (bash -c "echo rg"), each producing a spurious store-reaching finding for a command that performed no search at all. Added isCommandPosition(command, matchIndex): walks backward from the regex match skipping whitespace and requires the next non-whitespace char to be a clause separator (|, &, ;), an opening paren ('(' -- also covers '$(' since that string ends in '('), the literal word 'xargs', or start-of-string; anything else (a hyphen, a dot, a quote mid-argument) means the match is rejected before scanInvocationTokens ever runs. Deliberately kept this raw-text-based (not a full re-tokenization of the whole command) because CAM-460 AC2's own shape -- a genuine grep -rl hidden inside a bash -c '...$(grep ...)...' wrapper -- is an EXISTING regression test that must keep being flagged, and top-level tokenization would swallow the whole bash -c argument as one opaque quoted token, making that real invocation invisible; the '(' immediately preceding the tool word inside '$(' is what keeps that case working while still rejecting the four false-positive shapes. Added 6 new adversarial tests to test/issues/self-contaminating-search.test.ts (4 false-positive rejections + 2 true-positive preservations for $(...) and xargs) and 4 to test/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.test.ts (rule-level false-positive rejections, since the rule wraps the same predicate). No pattern-records.jsonl file exists in this repo yet (checked, only pattern-record.schema.json + patterns.md/patterns.archive.md are present), so appliedPatternIds is omitted -- nothing to report. check:all is fully green: test 5850/5850, embed-vendor, lint, file-size, debt-markers, version-skips, coverage, dead-code, dup, ci-parity, agents-md, test-sleeps, skip-ratchet all ok. Did not touch or stage scripts/cam/prd.json (it was already modified in the working tree before this story started, per the supervisor's own process -- not something the implementer edits per protocol).
